sections.heading: Base Location
items: Pick a shoreline with nearby wood, fiber, and a water source.
Leave room to expand. You will eventually need multiple crafting stations, storage, and a dock.
Place your main base near a fast-travel point or plan to build a Fast Travel Bell later.

sections.heading: Essential Structures
items: Workbench – the starting point for tools and repairs.
Storage boxes – label by resource type. Hoarding unorganized loot slows progression.
Dock/Wharf – required for ship upgrades and accessing larger vessels.

sections.heading: Defenses
items: Walls and gates protect against roaming mobs. Keep a clear kill zone in front of gates.
Place a Bonfire inside the compound for night safety and cooking.
Defensive spikes and traps are useful around the perimeter of advanced bases.
